board_row.note: Only the stable linked-row fields are read and gated. The mutable full plan/swarm/TASKS.json is never hashed, pinned or used as a digest source.

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the rate acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then implement or wrap a minimal reference using the relevant public adapter boundary and ship it as optional initially. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails.

caller_asset_contract.notes: Every declared asset is caller-owned and must exist at an absolute path with a matching lowercase SHA-256 before a caller may process audio. Validation is metadata-only and never reads, imports, loads or executes the model. No upstream revision is pinned here because the merged evidence records only the repository URL.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply the Beat This! source checkout at an immutable 40-hex revision under research/voice-enhancement-20261101/repos/beat_this or data/checkouts/beat_this; no checkout exists in the workspace.
Resolve https://github.com/CPJKU/beat_this to a full 40-hex commit and publish a per-file SHA-256 source manifest; the pinned research note records only the repository URL.

Supply the exact small or main PyTorch checkpoint, model configuration and any parameter metadata with byte counts and SHA-256 values at one immutable revision; no weight or config was downloaded, staged or identified by digest.

Record the exact sample rate, channels, resampling, window length, padding/crop recipe, duration limits and file-level boundary in a pinned configuration; the pinned note reports only file-level inference and model sizes, not task geometry.
Provide an isolated hash-pinned PyTorch runtime with a complete lock at data/envs/beat-this/requirements.lock and a recorded platform; no environment, package pin or lock exists.

Add the upstream licence text and terms at the resolved commit and verify that the grant covers both code and weights; the pinned note reports MIT but no licence file, terms statement or redistribution grant is present.

Clear weight, training-data, source-audio, label, output-use and redistribution rights, then freeze a rights-cleared held-out music cohort with beat, downbeat and tempo labels at matched tempi and meters; only analytic surrogates exist here.

Produce one approved exact-runtime Beat This! output on a frozen caller input plus beat/downbeat/tempo scores, target-device timing and independent review; no local output, parity vector, listening result or benchmark exists.

Clear source, weight, training-data, source-audio, output-use and redistribution rights with complete notices and a verified MIT grant covering code and weights.
Reproduce one exact-runtime Beat This! beat/downbeat output vector on a frozen caller input and configuration, including deterministic reset.
Score a rights-cleared held-out music cohort for beat F-measure, downbeat F-measure, tempo accuracy and tempo-octave errors against matched labels.
Establish the exact sample rate, channels, resampling, window, padding, file-level boundary and non-streaming limitation without inventing geometry.
Complete explicit opt-in provider or analysis-adapter intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision.
Record target-device timing, resource limits, independent exact-head review, explicit default selection and release or benchmark approval; this package is off by default.

licensing.note: MIT is reported for code and weights by the pinned research note, but no upstream licence text, rights grant or notice is present. The string is provenance only, never a task-file licence.
